title: More RLHF, More Trust? On The Impact of Preference Alignment On Trustworthiness
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus was on general trustworthiness verticals like toxicity, stereotypical bias, machine ethics, truthfulness, and privacy.
findings: The paper did not produce any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study.
